meta.title: Video breakdown
meta.description: Break one video or podcast into a structured report: shot table, frames and composition, transcript, on-screen text, editing rhythm, audio and BGM. A checklist is confirmed before anything runs; untested fields are labelled explicitly.

panel.title: Video breakdown
panel.subtitle: Link → checklist → breakdown → report
panel.idle: Paste a link or a local file, then build the checklist first.
panel.confirm_hint: The plan_id is the confirmation token for this exact configuration; changing parameters requires a new checklist.
